archetypes.name: ship-rebase-flow
archetypes.rationale: MAIN_ADVANCED now enters a duplicated rebase loop that must preserve counters and handoff state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the ship merge loop around MAIN_ADVANCED and CI_NOT_READY. Focus on counter increments, pre-rebase flush failure behavior, and PrePushConflictHandoff state preservation. Check that review-required probing remains limited to CI_NOT_READY. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sidecar-parity
archetypes.rationale: Conflict-fixer token ingestion now depends on fallback sidecar freshness and per-tier gating.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review Codex and Cursor conflict-fix launcher token ingestion. Verify stale fallback sidecars are cleared before launch, fallback ingestion cannot read stale data, and Claude remains unchanged. Check deduped seen-token behavior still permits record-vendor retries. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: progress-filter
archetypes.rationale: Live progress filtering mirrors shell Gantt filtering and could hide legitimate reviewer rows if too broad.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review live progress Gantt filtering for CI and probe rows. Compare task-kind and basename matching against the intended shell behavior. Confirm normal reviewer rows with ordinary outputs still render and full-path outputs are normalized by basename. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
